name: ops-cycle
description: The ops role's state machine (docs/specs/agent-roles.md, ops): idle -> readiness -> rollout -> steady -> incident, carried in a readiness/rollout record file's `status` frontmatter field plus a checklist section. capture-approval.sh (UserPromptSubmit) mints a single-use approval token only from an unambiguous statement in the user's own turn, bound to the record file and the specific (from, to) transition. state-gate.sh (PreToolUse) refuses readiness -> rollout unless every checklist item resolves to yes/no with a pointable artifact on every yes, refuses rollout -> steady without a matching approval token, and mechanically refuses any release transition out of steady once the error budget is recorded exhausted.
